# AI Usage and Cost Investigation
Filtered request, allocation, exception, and evidence ledgers for the **AI Usage and Cost Attribution** and **Attribution Pipeline Operations** dashboards.

**Locked workload scope:** `__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__`  
**Allowed APIM resource:** `__APIM_RESOURCE_ID__`  
**Allowed model resource:** `__FOUNDRY_RESOURCE_ID__`

Subject IDs are pseudonymous and restricted. Subscription-wide Claude CCU context is always shown separately and excluded from workload totals.

## Raw request ledger
Use `EventId`, `CorrelationId`, and `TraceId` for drill-through. This section only includes the exact demo resource group and Foundry account.

content.title: Filtered request rows

content.json:
## Raw allocation ledger
This append-only ledger keeps correction runs. Use the reconciliation section for the latest run per source path.

content.title: Filtered resource-group allocation rows

content.json:
## Exceptions and data quality
Review missing rates, missing usage, unmatched meters, unknown teams, token interruptions, and unavailable actuals.

content.title: Detailed exception rows

content.json:
## Request evidence and drill-through
The raw usage field contains provider usage metadata only. The processor does not store prompts or completions.

content.title: Request evidence

content.query:
let runFilter = '{RunId}';
AICostAllocation_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where SourceScope =~ '__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__'
| where runFilter == 'All' or RunId == runFilter
| summarize RowCount = count(), FirstRowUtc = min(TimeGenerated), LastRowUtc = max(TimeGenerated), SourceBilledCost = take_any(SourceBilledCost), SourceEffectiveCost = take_any(SourceEffectiveCost), AllocatedBilledCost = sum(AllocatedBilledCost), AllocatedEffectiveCost = sum(AllocatedEffectiveCost), UnallocatedBilledCost = sum(UnallocatedBilledCost), UnallocatedEffectiveCost = sum(UnallocatedEffectiveCost), Statuses = make_set(AttributionStatus, 20) by RunId, AllocationVersion, SourceType, SourcePath, SourceETag, IncludedInWorkloadTotal, ChargePeriodStart, ChargePeriodEnd, Provider, MeterId, MeterName, ResourceId
| summarize Rows = sum(RowCount), FirstRowUtc = min(FirstRowUtc), LastRowUtc = max(LastRowUtc), Providers = make_set(Provider, 20), Meters = make_set(MeterName, 50), SourceBilledCost = sum(SourceBilledCost), SourceEffectiveCost = sum(SourceEffectiveCost), AllocatedBilledCost = sum(AllocatedBilledCost), AllocatedEffectiveCost = sum(AllocatedEffectiveCost), UnallocatedBilledCost = sum(UnallocatedBilledCost), UnallocatedEffectiveCost = sum(UnallocatedEffectiveCost), Statuses = make_set(Statuses, 20) by RunId, AllocationVersion, SourceType, SourcePath, SourceETag, IncludedInWorkloadTotal
| order by LastRowUtc desc
| take 500
content.title: Allocation run evidence

content.json:
## Latest-run reconciliation
Reporting selects the newest run for each source path. Residuals retain negative adjustments and corrections.

content.query:
let providerFilter = '{Provider}';
let scopedRows = AICostAllocation_CL
| where SourceScope =~ '__RESOURCE_GROUP_ID__' and IncludedInWorkloadTotal == true;
let latestRuns = scopedRows
| summarize arg_max(TimeGenerated, RunId) by SourcePath
| project SourcePath, RunId;
latestRuns
| join kind=inner (scopedRows) on SourcePath, RunId
| where ChargePeriodStart {TimeRange}
| where providerFilter == 'All' or Provider == providerFilter
| extend SourceAuthority = coalesce(SourceEffectiveCost, SourceBilledCost), AllocatedAuthority = coalesce(AllocatedEffectiveCost, AllocatedBilledCost), UnallocatedAuthority = coalesce(UnallocatedEffectiveCost, UnallocatedBilledCost)
| summarize SourceCost = take_any(SourceAuthority), AllocatedCost = sum(AllocatedAuthority), UnallocatedCost = sum(UnallocatedAuthority) by RunId, SourcePath, SourceETag, ChargePeriodStart, ChargePeriodEnd, Provider, MeterId, MeterName, ResourceId, BillingCurrency
| extend Residual = SourceCost - AllocatedCost - UnallocatedCost, ReconciliationFactor = iff(SourceCost == 0, real(null), (AllocatedCost + UnallocatedCost) / SourceCost)
| extend AbsoluteResidual = abs(Residual)
| order by AbsoluteResidual desc, ChargePeriodStart desc
| take 1000
content.title: Latest source-bucket reconciliation

content.json:
## Subscription-wide Claude CCU external context
These rows must have `IncludedInWorkloadTotal=false`. They are not a resource-group allocation fallback or denominator.

content.query:
let runFilter = '{RunId}';
AICostAllocation_CL
| where TimeGenerated {TimeRange}
| where SourceScope == 'subscription' and SourceType == 'cost-management-query'
| where Provider =~ 'Anthropic' and MeterName in~ ('Claude Consumption Unit', 'Claude Consumption Unit (CCU)')
| where IncludedInWorkloadTotal == false
| where runFilter == 'All' or RunId == runFilter
| project TimeGenerated, ChargePeriodStart, ChargePeriodEnd, Provider, PublisherName, MeterName, BillingCurrency, SourceBilledCost, AttributionStatus, IncludedInWorkloadTotal, RunId, SourcePath, SourceETag
| order by ChargePeriodStart desc
| take 1000
content.title: Excluded external Claude CCU rows
